GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT
  l.l_shipmode,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'

WITH country_code_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_custkey,
        LEFT(c.c_phone, 2) AS cntrycode,
        c.c_acctbal,
        o.o_orderkey
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE LEFT(c.c_phone, 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
      AND c.c_acctbal > 0.00
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM orders o2
          WHERE o2.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
      )
)
SELECT 
    cntrycode,
    COUNT(*) AS numcust,
    SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
FROM country_code_customer
GROUP BY cntrycode
ORDER BY cntrycode

WITH country_code_stats AS (
            SELECT
                SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2) AS cntrycode,
                AVG(c_acctbal) AS avg_bal
            FROM customer
            WHERE SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
            GROUP BY cntrycode
        )
        SELECT
            cntrycode,
            COUNT(*) AS numcust,
            SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
        FROM customer
        WHERE SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
          AND c_acctbal > 0.00
          AND c_acctbal > (SELECT avg_bal FROM country_code_stats WHERE cntrycode = SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2))
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = c_custkey)
        GROUP BY cntrycode
        ORDER BY cntrycode

    l.l_shipmode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
  AND l.l_receiptdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l.l_receiptdate < '1995-01-01'
  AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
  AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY l.l_shipmode

SELECT
          s.s_name,
          COUNT(*) AS numwait
        FROM
          supplier s
        JOIN
          nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN
          orders o ON s.s_suppkey = o.o_orderkey
        JOIN
          lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
        WHERE
          n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
          AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
          AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
          AND o.o_orderkey IN (
              SELECT o2.o_orderkey
              FROM lineitem l2
              WHERE l2.l_orderkey = o2.o_orderkey
              AND l2.l_suppkey != s.s_suppkey
              AND l2.l_receiptdate > l2.l_commitdate
          )
        GROUP BY
          s.s_name
        ORDER BY
          numwait DESC,
          s.s_name ASC
        LIMIT 100
